description: TDD implementation of per-station bell icon in StationCard component and updated header bell dialog showing subscribed stations - write tests FIRST then implement
steps: TESTS FIRST - Create src/components/__tests__/StationCard.test.tsx with tests for: renders a bell icon button; bell icon shows filled/active state when station is subscribed; bell icon shows outline/inactive state when not subscribed; clicking bell calls subscribe when not subscribed; clicking bell calls unsubscribe when subscribed; bell click does not trigger the card's onSelect handler (stopPropagation)

TESTS FIRST - Create src/components/__tests__/NotificationHandler.test.tsx with tests for: renders dialog with list of subscribed stations (reading from localStorage/service); shows empty state when no stations subscribed; each subscribed station has an unsubscribe button; clicking unsubscribe removes station from list

Update src/components/StationCard.tsx: add a bell icon button (using BellIcon from IconLibrary) in the header row. Use useStationSubscription hook for state. Use Bell (outline) when not subscribed, BellRing (filled) when subscribed from lucide-react. Add onClick handler with e.stopPropagation(). The station ID to pass is station.id.toString().
Add BellRingIcon export to src/components/icons/IconLibrary.tsx using BellRing from lucide-react (following existing pattern for BellIcon)

Replace src/components/NotificationHandler.tsx: change from global toggle to a dialog that shows subscribed stations list. Use getSubscribedStations() from notificationService to get station IDs. Display station names (can be fetched or stored alongside IDs). Show 'No stations subscribed' empty state. Each station row has an unsubscribe button.
Run npx vitest run to confirm all tests pass
Run npm run build to confirm TypeScript compiles
acceptance_criteria: StationCard renders bell icon with correct subscribed/unsubscribed visual state
Bell click subscribes/unsubscribes without triggering card selection
NotificationHandler dialog shows list of subscribed stations
findings: All 38 tests pass (28 existing + 10 new). TDD approach followed: wrote tests first (confirmed they failed), then implemented code to make them pass. StationCard bell button uses data-subscribed attribute for test assertions and aria-label='Toggle notification subscription' for accessibility. NotificationHandler was completely replaced from a global toggle to a per-station subscription list dialog. BellRingIcon added to IconLibrary following existing pattern. Build succeeds with no TypeScript errors.
